name: Sgt. Lowry (or Lowery)
summary: A Special Forces sergeant Larry remembers as operating or being stationed on top of Núi Bà Đen (Black Virgin Mountain). The correct spelling of his name and his identity remain unresolved.
larrysRecollection: Larry remembers a Special Forces Sergeant Lowry or Lowery who operated or was stationed on top of Núi Bà Đen.
researchNotes: Both spellings should be searched in Special Forces rosters, unit records, and veteran accounts of Núi Bà Đen operations during 1964-1965. No documentary match has been found yet.
